wholePhysicalScope: Named OSM way 443980226 sets the stepped enclosing line, 1297335679 identifies the masonry drum, and 1297335680 fixes the position and diameter of its dome.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the rocky terrace, mapped main dome and six arched facade bays. Near levels show the pierced parapet, timber window divisions and rubble retaining walls.
limitations: The original elevation field captures the broader rock slope. The historic enclosure, some retained terrace heights, stair widths, interior courtyard arrangement and modern masonry colors are approximate.

The cleared panorama was photographed in 2004. The principal dome’s mapped roof extents are current. The model simplifies its finish, smaller stone vaults and service enclosures. Sacred interiors and hillside approaches outside the shrine are omitted.
